paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁，揭示了结构化状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的深层理论联系 [S1.p2][S3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了一种新的 SSD 算法，利用半可分矩阵的分块分解，在保持线性复杂度的同时利用矩阵乘法单元，比 Mamba 的优化扫描实现快 2-8 倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者进一步提出了 Mamba-2 架构，其核心层是 Mamba 选择性 SSM 的改进，在语言建模上保持与 Transformer 的竞争力 [abstract]。实验表明，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上均优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++，并在标准下游评估中匹配或超越同规模开源 Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 本文旨在建立结构化 SSM 与注意力变体之间的丰富理论联系，从而将原本为 Transformer 开发的算法和系统优化迁移到 SSM，以构建在序列长度上扩展更高效且性能更好的基础模型 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM 的发展与社区改进 Transformer 的努力（如理论理解和硬件优化）显得脱节，导致 SSM 比 Transformer 更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度训练 SSM 与训练 Transformer 一样高效仍具挑战 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective.

method.text: 作者提出了结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一结构化矩阵类，将 SSM 与注意力变体联系起来 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。该框架表明 SSM 等价于半可分矩阵，并证明具有快速循环形式的核注意力方法必然是 SSM [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。基于此，作者提出了 SSD 算法，通过对半可分矩阵进行分块分解，对角块使用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为较小的循环，从而结合线性 SSM 循环和二次对偶形式的优势 [S6.p4]。作者还设计了 Mamba-2 架构，其核心层是 Mamba 选择性 SSM 的改进，并引入了多头注意力中头的类比以及分组值注意力等设计 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1][S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p2]。

evidence.quote: Our framework connecting structured SSMs and variants of attention, which we call structured state space duality (SSD), is made through the abstractions of structured matrices
We show an equivalence between state space models and a well-studied family of structured matrices called semiseparable matrices
We also prove that any kernel attention method possessing a fast recurrent form must be an SSM.
we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence.
we introduce the analog of heads from multi-head attention (MHA) to SSMs.
The main ideas include introducing grouped-value attention (GVA) head structure

experiments.text: 作者在合成联想回忆任务（MQAR）上评估了 Mamba-2，该任务对循环模型具有挑战性 [S9.p1][S9.SS1.p1]。在语言建模方面，作者在 Pile 数据集上训练了从约 125M 到 2.7B 参数的模型，遵循 GPT3 规格和 Chinchilla 协议，并与 Mamba 和 Transformer++ 进行比较 [S9.SS2.p1][S9.SS2.SSS1.p2]。作者还进行了速度基准测试，将 SSD 算法与 Mamba 的扫描实现和 FlashAttention-2 进行对比 [S9.SS3.p1]。此外，作者消融了 Mamba-2 架构的多种设计选择，包括块设计、头结构和注意力核近似 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p1][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We empirically evaluate Mamba-2 on synthetic recall tasks that have been challenging for recurrent models
The multi-query associative recall (MQAR) task is a particular formulation of this task that requires the model to memorize multiple associations.
We use the Pile dataset, and follow the training recipe described in.
Figure 9 shows scaling laws under the standard Chinchilla protocol, on models from $\approx 125M$ to $\approx 1.3B$ parameters.
We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block
Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture.
We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Figure 12.

findings.text: SSD 算法比 Mamba 的融合关联扫描快 2-8 倍，并且由于线性扩展，在序列长度 2K 时开始快于 FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。在 MQAR 任务上，Mamba-2 在所有设置下表现良好，显著优于 Mamba-1，即使控制状态大小（N=16）也是如此 [S9.SS1.p3]。在语言建模中，Mamba-2 在困惑度和实际运行时间上均帕累托优于 Mamba 和 Transformer++ [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。下游评估中，2.7B 参数的 Mamba-2 在 Pile 上训练 300B token 后，优于 Mamba-2.8B、Pythia-2.8B 甚至 Pythia-6.9B [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。消融实验表明，并行投影和额外归一化层略微提升性能，多值注意力头模式表现最佳，而核近似方法未超过简单逐点非线性激活 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p2][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: it is 2-8 $\times$ faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length $2K$.
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ($\mathtt{N}=16$).
finding that it Pareto dominates Mamba and Transformer++ in both perplexity and wall-clock time.
Mamba-2 with 2.7B parameters trained on 300B tokens on the Pile outperforms Mamba-2.8B, Pythia-2.8B and even Pythia-6.9B
The ablations validate that parallel projections to create $(A,B,C,X)$ saves parameters and performs slightly better
the extra normalization layer also slightly improves performance.
we find a large difference between multi-value and multi-query or multi-key head patterns
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions

limitations.text: 作者指出，SSD 相比 Mamba 仅在 $A_t$ 的对角形式上更具限制性，以牺牲部分表达能力换取硬件效率提升 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者假设可能可以改进结构化矩阵算法以推广到一般对角 SSM 情况 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p2]。在 MQAR 任务上，作者不确定架构的哪个方面是主要因素，这仍是未来工作的问题 [S9.SS1.p3]。作者还指出，Mamba-2 模型整体在短序列长度（如 2K）下训练效率可能不如 Transformer，因为相同参数量下 Mamba-2 有 L 个 SSD 层而 Transformer 有 L/2 个 MLP 层和 L/2 个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。此外，SSD 不推广标准 softmax 注意力或任何没有有限特征映射的注意力核变换 [S10.SS3.p8]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions $A_{t}$.
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal $A_{t}$, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
We hypothesize that it may be possible to refine our structured matrix algorithms to improve to the general diagonal SSM case as well.
We are not sure which aspect of the architecture is the predominant factor, which remains a question to explore in future work.
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length
SSD does not generalize standard softmax attention, or any other transformation on the attention kernel matrix that does not have a finite feature map $\psi$.
